subject: ROLE_ORCHESTRATION_REVIEW_DEPTH_OVERREACH
observed_fact: During CAP-01 implementation review, early Reviewer findings identified concrete contract defects and were valid. After the production behavior became correct, later closure rounds continued to block Task completion because individually enumerated direct regression tests were missing for behaviors already independently demonstrated as correct. The Reviewer was not acting outside its supplied authority: GPT remediation and re-review instructions had progressively promoted verification details and specific test-matrix items into blocking acceptance criteria.
impact: Review depth can expand recursively even after the governed behavior is correct. Verification methods can become de facto new authority, causing repeated remediation/re-review loops, unnecessary test-permutation growth, delayed Work Unit closure, and framework-development churn that is disproportionate to the remaining risk.
current_workaround: GPT manually adjudicates whether a remaining Reviewer observation is a concrete accepted-authority defect or only missing hardening coverage. Once production behavior is independently proven correct, test-only hardening is separated from production remediation and the review scope is explicitly narrowed.
preservation_evidence: Independent Reviewer scrutiny must be preserved because it caught real fail-closed schema and protocol defects in the same CAP-01 Work Unit. The optimization should bound depth rather than weaken review: concrete contract defects, accepted-authority omissions and demonstrated regressions remain blocking; additional test hardening for already-correct behavior should not become blocking unless the accepted Design/Plan explicitly makes that test an acceptance requirement or concrete regression evidence justifies it.

optimization_candidate.name: AUTHORITY_BOUNDED_REVIEW_DEPTH_AND_NON_ESCALATION
minimum_closure_hypothesis: Remediation and re-review instructions must not strengthen accepted Design/Plan acceptance criteria unless required to close an already accepted finding
Verification method or suggested test technique is not automatically a new acceptance requirement
Reviewer findings remain blocking for concrete contract defects, accepted-authority omissions, or demonstrated regressions
When behavior is independently proven correct, missing additional regression-test permutations default to non-blocking hardening unless explicitly required by accepted authority
Reviewer depth is bounded by the current finding and Work Unit authority; closure review must not recursively expand the test matrix
GPT adjudication must distinguish production correctness from optional preservation/hardening coverage

authority_boundary: This evidence records an observed orchestration gap only. It does not modify the accepted Design, accepted Plan, CAP-01 acceptance criteria, Reviewer authority, or current Framework behavior. Any Framework change requires a later Framework Optimization Review and explicit user approval.
